text:
Elaine P: kicking off coordination for Credential Bridge launch with KeyVaultCo (HSM/KMS) + IdP partner. Need SSO/SCIM/KMS readiness + marketplace listing timeline. Target launch: 2026-05-15. Owners: SSO Ajay, SCIM Maria, KMS Vikram, SI partner liaison Elaine. Please ack and call out blockers.

Ajay S: ack. Quick Q: IdP needs SAML metadata—are we embedding cert rotation support? We support >1 signing cert. Will publish metadata endpoint and a test SAML assertion.

Vikram K: on KMS/HSM side: need BYOK flow doc, HSM connector cert requirements, and acceptance tests. For the HSM we require PKCS#11 v2.40 and a CSR-generated client cert. I'll draft checklist and CSR template.

Maria L: SCIM mapping notes: mapping for groups + roles. Proposed attrs: `userName -> externalId`, `emails[0].value -> email`, `meta.lastModified -> updated_at`. Sample JSON patch for provisioning update: ```json
[{ "op": "replace", "path": "/schemas", "value": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"] }]
```
Will produce full attribute map doc.

Ajay S: pinging @Vikram for KMS rotation schedule. Also need marketplace tenant scoping decision (shared vs dedicated offering). Which one do we list initially?

Vikram K: rotation: default auto-rotate every 90d, but partner wants manual rotate option too — we can support both. For HSM client certs vendor asks for `subjectAltName` with CN=redwood-inference-client. I'll upload CSR template to the shared drive.

Elaine P: Marketing/PR notes: embargo date 2026-05-10. Legal needs signoff on joint statement by 2026-04-20. @Maria please assemble integration screenshots and a short demo clip. @Ajay please confirm the staging demo link once infra ready.

Maria L: Got it. I'll prepare a 90s demo and 2 screenshots, and a short integration blurb for the marketplace listing. Deliver by 2026-04-28.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging cluster provisioning for partner-credential-bridge scheduled for 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC.

Ajay S: Staging demo link will be https://staging.redwood.ai/partner/credential-bridge — will confirm once provisioning completes.

Vikram K: Risk note: SCIM group sync cadence could hit rate limits. Suggest initial limits: 5 req/s per tenant + a 24h full-sync delta for large groups. Also cache group membership for 5m for UI calls.

Maria L: +1 on caching. For UI please surface `last_synced_at` and a small retry/backoff UI hint for admins.

Elaine P: Action items summary: 1) Ajay provide SAML metadata + demo link 2) Maria finalize SCIM mapping + marketing assets 3) Vikram provide KMS/HSM CSR template + BYOK doc + acceptance tests 4) Legal & Marketing timelines noted. We'll have a short sync Tue 2026-03-30 16:00 PT. React :thumbsup: to confirm.
